query: SELECT oid, main_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, pm_err_maj, pm_err_min, pm_err_angle, pm_bibcode, plx_value, plx_err, plx_bibcode, otype, sp_type, sp_bibcode, nbref FROM basic WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 133.759765, -7.242182, 0.080278)) AND (pmra * pmra + pmdec * pmdec > 4000000 OR 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 133.759765, -7.242182, 0.018889)))
